title: A manuscript with a chapter map
description: Events and decisions stay tied to the places in the book where they appeared.

blocks.text: A continuation of a long text easily contradicts the early chapters. Retelling the project before every edit takes time.

quote.text: The app tries to change you story or add extra stuff that isn’t wanted. If you make a book more than ten chapters it will forget events that have already happened

blocks.text: Assemble an overview of the scenes and of the accepted facts and tie them to the manuscript. Before continuing, show which context will be used.
Do not promise flawless memory of the whole book. Questionable connections and incomplete context have to be visible, and the author’s own versions have to be kept.
